scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && node server.js
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && node --watch server.js

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Express backend has no build step required')"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
